legend: Given an array a%%ZSMJ0%% of length n%%ZSMJ1%% (1≤n≤2∗105)%%ZSMJ2%% its elements are numbered from 0 to n−1%%ZSMJ3%% (a0,a1,...,an−1)%%ZSMJ4%%.

first set an integer current%%ZSMJ9%% to start%%ZSMJ10%% and set another integer sum%%ZSMJ11%% to zero, that is current=start%%ZSMJ12%% and sum=0%%ZSMJ13%%.Then repeat this steps n%%ZSMJ14%% times:
